name: All our files, read in as cells, share one graph
asks: read in all our files as cells sharing the same graph

met-when.says: Cells that codecs produce from files of different formats are added to one graph, and a cell two files both yield is one cell of that graph, by its address.
A relation from a cell of one file to a cell of another is a relation of the graph like any other and is found by the same queries.
Every tracked file of the bare-cedar-fog superproject and its sections that a codec can read is added to one graph in one run by a downstream loader; SignGraph itself opens no file.

sources.words: read in all our files as cells sharing the same graph
